description: This file defines a JavaScript module for handling dependent dropdowns in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes functions for generating dropdown elements dynamically, managing dependencies, and debugging.

methods.name: handleDependentDropdown
methods.description: Handles the logic for dependent dropdowns when a user interacts with a dropdown element.

methods.name: generateElement
methods.description: Generates and inserts a form element (input, select, etc.) based on metadata, and triggers cascading dependencies.
